items.head: Stop announcing your plans
items.sub: Show the result. Skip the speech.

items.head: Gym 4 days minimum
items.sub: No skipping because work was long.

items.head: Protein at every meal
items.sub: Eggs, chicken, Greek yogurt. Every plate.

items.head: Delete the apps that eat your day
items.sub: Check your screen time. Delete the top 2.

items.head: Cut off friends keeping you small
items.sub: The ones who laugh when you start.

items.head: Save before you spend
items.sub: Move 10% out on payday, first thing.

text: 90 days from now you'll be 90 days older. *Be someone new too.*
